description.text: IntroductionThis program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.Main CoursesInternational Trade Practice, International Trade, International Finance, International Investment, International Marketing, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, etc.InternshipThey will be able to handle international business and economic cooperation.Future CareerThey will be qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations.

duration.text: The International Economics and Trade at Beihang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3. Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4. Academic transcript of high school5. Health certificate(optional)Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants are expected to study hard, observe the Chinese laws and the regulations of BUAA and have the equivalent of a high school education. 2.Applicants are expected to have good scores and studied hard in high school. 3.Applicants should be under thirty five years old in general.4.Applicants should attend the entrance examination and meet the requirements of BUAA.
